meta.name: render-editorial-motion-podcast
meta.description: Assemble an editorial-motion podcast-clip ad from a config — a real clipped podcast MP3 carries the narrative while N flat 2-tone editorial-illustration keyframes are animated NOT by generative i2v but by DETERMINISTIC ffmpeg ken-burns (zoompan) + hard cuts (no crossfades, which expose geometric drift), each beat snapped to its spoken line, the real audio muxed, Whisper-driven captions burned only mid-sentence, and closed on a PIL brand end card — never AI-rendered text. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (ffmpeg ken-burns + hard concat + audio mux + captions + end card); the real audio is clipped from source and the keyframes come from create-image-fal. Use for the editorial-motion-podcast format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将配置自动组装成带动画的播客广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从音频和插画素材自动生成播客广告视频
copy.tagline_en: Assemble a podcast ad video with animations from a config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to auto-generate podcast ad videos from audio and illustration assets

howto.what: 这个技能会把一段真实的播客音频、几张静态插画和品牌标志，自动合成一个带字幕和片尾卡片的短视频广告。它用ffmpeg让插画缓慢缩放，在每句话开始时切换画面，并只在说话时显示字幕。
howto.when: 当你提供一段播客音频、每句话对应的插画和品牌标志，并希望生成一个编辑风格的播客片段广告时触发。

say.text: 用这段播客音频和这些插画，生成一个播客片段广告。
say.note: 技能会按音频节奏自动匹配插画和字幕。

say.text: 把这段音频和插画合成一个带字幕的短视频。
say.note: 技能会使用ffmpeg进行确定性合成，不涉及AI生成视频。

howto.what_en: This skill assembles a real podcast audio clip, static illustrations, and a brand logo into a short video ad with captions and an end card. It uses ffmpeg to apply ken-burns zoom to illustrations, hard-cuts on each spoken line, and burns captions only mid-sentence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a podcast audio clip, per-beat illustrations, and a brand logo, and want to produce an editorial-motion podcast-clip ad.

say_en.text: Use this podcast audio and these illustrations to create a podcast clip ad.
say_en.note: The skill will match illustrations and captions to the audio rhythm.

say_en.text: Combine this audio and these illustrations into a short video with captions.
say_en.note: The skill uses deterministic ffmpeg, no AI-generated video.
